text:
AnitaP: Thanks for joining todays all-hands. Thread for quick follow-ups on hiring tranches, small-team merges, and shadowing opportunities. Keep qs short.

JordanK: Are the 30 seats guaranteed or conditional? Need to tell my EMs if we can open reqs now.

AnitaP: Good Q. 30 seats are approved at a high level but will be released in two tranches (Q1 and Q3). Q1 tranche is prioritized for infra/runtime and SRE. Well publish which teams get Q1 slots next week.

NiaS: If someone rotates into infra temporarily, does that consume a seat or is it considered a secondment?

PeopleOpsBot: FYI: internal rotations/secondments are treated as net-zero for headcount but must be logged and approved by the home manager and People Ops. Backfills are still required if the home role is vacated long term.

OmarV: For the small-team merges mentioned: any changes to on-call or comp banding?

AnitaP: Merges aim to reduce duplicated on-call and improve SLA ownership. No band changes planned as part of merges. If someones role scope increases, promotion/comp conversations follow the usual process.

PriyaK: Recruiting note: managers can start req paperwork for Q1-priority roles; well greenlight scheduling once tranche approvals are pinned. Internal candidates flagged in Greenhouse get priority scheduling.

JordanK: Can leadership share a one-page manager comms template so messaging is consistent across teams?

AnitaP: Yes. Template will include: why the change, whos impacted, timeline, support available, and contact points. Well post it in #people-ops and attach to the all-hands follow-up doc by EOD Fri.

NiaS: Any fast-track for internal applicants into manager roles created by the merge?

PeopleOpsBot: Internal applicants get scheduling priority but still go through the standard calibration/promotion steps. You can request an expedited panel if theres an operational need.

RecruiterBot: Reminder: referral uplift for critical infra hires starts next week (+$5k). Details in #recruiting.

AllHandsBot: Slides and recording: https://redwood/all-hands/2509999999. Action items summarized in the follow-up doc.

AnitaP: Thanks all. If you have private concerns about moves or comp, DM People Ops or me. Closing in 48h unless other Qs.
